cleaning: NFC, HTML unescape, whitespace normalization; exact text duplicate removal within source; conservative email/address/numeric-sequence redaction; source encodings not repaired; no sentiment or topic labels added.
scope: Published keyword samples contain mixed countries/languages, promotions, social posts and discussion; source title is not a verified topical relevance label. No claim that these are representative Indonesian sellers/buyers.
pdf_extraction_limit: Date-delimited original reading order. Source IDs and original tweet URLs absent in PDF. Page and row locators retained; encoding artifacts and extraction errors possible.
date_notes: PDF source posts appear January2024; dataset publication2025. CSV publicationJan2026 and its tweet timestamps are Jan2026. Dates recorded per row.
